name: Shippo no Kimochi
source:
Main character is approached by a daughter of father's director. She claims that it makes her protagonist's boss as well and invites him to become her pet. There's no particular rejection of the idea, but what kind of life will now start for him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被父亲上司的女儿找上。她声称既然如此，自己也算主角的上司，并邀请他成为她的宠物。主角并不特别排斥这个提议，但等待他的会是怎样的生活？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
